_meta.basis: 2 adults, 1 room, 7 nights (Feb 15–22, 2027 benchmark plus Feb 15–Mar 22, 2027 seasonality), queen+ bed and verified private bathroom.
_meta.tax_rule: Direct SynXis quotes for Pod 51, Pod 39, Pod Times Square, HGU New York, and Shoreham show all-in totals including taxes & fees; Booking.com snapshots and Arlo quotes exclude NYC hotel taxes (~14.75% + $3.50/night occupancy fee) and are labeled separately.
_meta.price_caveat: Live direct SynXis/Arlo quotes captured 2026-11-26 for Feb 15–Mar 22, 2027; third-party Booking.com snapshots captured 2026-11-25. Always verify cancellation deadlines and tax breakdown at checkout.
_meta.search_page_cheapest_total_usd: The cheapest total shown on Booking.com's New York search-results card for the same dates — sometimes a different room type than the rate tiers listed. If the room type is unknown, the bed rule cannot be confirmed for that figure.
_meta.excluded: Pod/hostel-style bunk products (e.g. a 'Pod Bunk' twin at ~$700) were excluded because they fail the queen-or-larger bed rule.
_meta.michelin_ranking_caveat: Measured door-to-door weekday evening (18:30) travel times from official NYC GeoSearch / US Census coordinates to all 69 active NYC MICHELIN starred venues via live MTA GTFS Subway timetable (feed 20261101–20270515). Excludes Blue Hill at Stone Barns (Tarrytown), La Bastide (North Salem), and indefinitely closed Shion 69 Leonard Street. See research/generated/transit_1h.json for every hotel × restaurant route and duration.
_meta.seasonality_summary: Multi-week direct SynXis check on Pod 51 (Queen Pod, 2 adults, all-in): Feb 15–22 ($1,109) and Feb 22–Mar 1 ($1,138) are the cheapest weeks in the window, rising +47% in Mar 1–8 ($1,628) and +81% in Mar 15–22 ($2,004). 14-night Feb 15–Mar 1 all-in totals: Pod 51 $2,246, Pod 39 $2,356, HGU Queen Deluxe $2,432.
